project_stage: Stage 6 - Leakage-Safe Feature Engineering & Chronological Validation Design

features.name: date
features.description: Target calendar date.

features.name: d
features.description: Original M5 daily key.

features.name: wm_yr_wk
features.description: Original M5 week key used for weekly prices.

features.name: item_id
features.description: Product identifier shared across stores.

features.name: dept_id
features.description: FOODS department identifier.

features.name: cat_id
features.description: Category identifier; constant FOODS in V1.
features.leakage_notes: Constant in Version 1, so excluded from default features.

features.name: store_id
features.description: Store identifier.

features.name: state_id
features.description: State identifier.

features.name: availability_date
features.description: First known selling-price date for the item-store pair.
features.leakage_notes: M5 price availability proxy, not explicit inventory availability.

features.name: is_active
features.description: True for every retained row on or after availability.
features.leakage_notes: Constant true after pre-launch filtering; retained for auditability.

features.name: product_age_days
features.description: Days since first known price, starting at zero.

features.name: product_age_weeks
features.description: Completed weeks since first known price.

features.name: day_of_week
features.description: Monday=0 through Sunday=6.

features.name: day_of_month
features.description: Calendar day within month.

features.name: month
features.description: Calendar month 1-12.

features.name: quarter
features.description: Calendar quarter 1-4.

features.name: year
features.description: Calendar year.

features.name: week_of_year
features.description: ISO calendar week 1-53.

features.name: is_weekend
features.description: True on Saturday or Sunday.

features.name: day_of_week_sin
features.description: Sine encoding of the seven-day cycle.

features.name: day_of_week_cos
features.description: Cosine encoding of the seven-day cycle.

features.name: month_sin
features.description: Sine encoding of the 12-month cycle.

features.name: month_cos
features.description: Cosine encoding of the 12-month cycle.

features.name: is_event
features.description: True when either M5 event slot is populated.

features.name: event_name_1
features.description: Raw M5 calendar field event_name_1.
features.leakage_notes: Missing means no event in that slot; no target encoding is applied.

features.name: event_type_1
features.description: Raw M5 calendar field event_type_1.
features.leakage_notes: Missing means no event in that slot; no target encoding is applied.

features.name: event_name_2
features.description: Raw M5 calendar field event_name_2.
features.leakage_notes: Missing means no event in that slot; no target encoding is applied.

features.name: event_type_2
features.description: Raw M5 calendar field event_type_2.
features.leakage_notes: Missing means no event in that slot; no target encoding is applied.

features.name: snap_active
features.description: Store-relevant state SNAP calendar flag.

features.name: sales_lag_1
features.description: Sales for the same item-store pair 1 day(s) before the target date.
features.leakage_notes: Grouped by store_id and item_id before shifting.

features.name: sales_lag_7
features.description: Sales for the same item-store pair 7 day(s) before the target date.
features.leakage_notes: Grouped by store_id and item_id before shifting.

features.name: sales_lag_14
features.description: Sales for the same item-store pair 14 day(s) before the target date.
features.leakage_notes: Grouped by store_id and item_id before shifting.

features.name: sales_lag_28
features.description: Sales for the same item-store pair 28 day(s) before the target date.
features.leakage_notes: Grouped by store_id and item_id before shifting.

features.name: sales_roll_mean_7
features.description: Mean of sales from t-7 through t-1.
features.leakage_notes: Calculated with shift(1) before rolling.

features.name: sales_roll_mean_14
features.description: Mean of sales from t-14 through t-1.
features.leakage_notes: Calculated with shift(1) before rolling.

features.name: sales_roll_mean_28
features.description: Mean of sales from t-28 through t-1.
features.leakage_notes: Calculated with shift(1) before rolling.

features.name: sales_roll_std_7
features.description: Sample standard deviation of sales from t-7 through t-1.
features.leakage_notes: Calculated with shift(1) before rolling.

features.name: sales_roll_std_28
features.description: Sample standard deviation of sales from t-28 through t-1.
features.leakage_notes: Calculated with shift(1) before rolling.

features.name: zero_rate_7
features.description: Share of zero-sales observations from t-7 through t-1.
features.leakage_notes: Missing history stays missing; zero demand is not treated as missing.

features.name: zero_rate_28
features.description: Share of zero-sales observations from t-28 through t-1.
features.leakage_notes: Missing history stays missing; zero demand is not treated as missing.

features.name: days_since_last_positive_sale
features.description: Calendar days since the latest positive sale strictly before the target date.
features.leakage_notes: The target day's sale is never inspected.

features.name: previous_week_price
features.description: Selling price in the immediately preceding item-store M5 week.

features.name: price_change_previous_week
features.description: Previous-week price minus the price two weeks before the target week.

features.name: price_pct_change_previous_week
features.description: 100 times previous-week price divided by two-weeks-ago price minus one.
features.leakage_notes: No clipping or capping is applied.

features.name: price_vs_4week_median_lagged
features.description: Previous-week price divided by the median of the four weeks before the target week, minus one.
features.leakage_notes: Weekly-aware and based only on completed prior weeks.

features.name: known_future_sell_price
features.description: Actual price recorded for the target date/week.
features.leakage_notes: Scenario-only field; excluded from the default forecast-safe feature set.

features.name: demand_band
features.description: Stage 4 full-history low/medium/high stratum.
features.leakage_notes: Full-history target aggregate; prohibited as a model predictor.

features.name: is_feature_ready
features.description: True when every required past-demand and past-price feature is available.
features.leakage_notes: Controls row eligibility and is not a predictor.

features.name: sales
features.description: Observed unit sales on the target date.
features.leakage_notes: Untransformed regression target; never a feature for the same row.
